id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: CXL 1.x is point-to-point host↔device over one Flex Bus link. CXL 2.0 adds tree-based switching for multi-device attach and cross-host memory pooling. CXL 3.0 adds multi-level switching and Port-Based-Routing fabrics (mesh / ring / spine-leaf) of up to 4,096 nodes, where each node may be a host or a device of any type, with GFAM memory nodes attached directly to switches and memory sharing across devices in one coherency domain.

supported_topologies.name: Point-to-point (CXL 1.x)
supported_topologies.description: One host, one device over a single Flex Bus link.

supported_topologies.name: Tree switch fabric (CXL 2.0)
supported_topologies.description: Switch connects multiple devices to a host; memory pooling across hosts.

supported_topologies.name: Multi-level switch + PBR fabric (CXL 3.0)
supported_topologies.description: Non-tree mesh / ring / spine-leaf topologies of up to 4,096 nodes.

supported_topologies.name: GFAM node (CXL 3.0)
supported_topologies.description: Type 3 Global Fabric Attached Memory attached to a switch without a direct host link.

supported_topologies.name: Memory sharing (CXL 3.0)
supported_topologies.description: Multiple devices share the same memory segment in one coherency domain.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Sole cache agent + home agent; issues H2D snoops + M2S memory requests; enumerates devices via CXL.io.
Coherent accelerator; issues D2H requests to cache host memory; no device memory.
Accelerator with local memory; caches host memory (CXL.cache) + exposes device memory (CXL.mem).
Memory expander; exposes device-attached memory via CXL.mem.
Fabric switching (tree in 2.0; multi-level + PBR in 3.0); enables pooling/sharing.

fields.interconnect_role: CXL is a cache-coherent interconnect over the PCIe Flex Bus. Unlike plain PCIe (a non-coherent I/O tree), CXL adds host-coherent device caching (CXL.cache) and host-coherent device memory (CXL.mem), and in 3.0 a Port-Based-Routing fabric for disaggregated, pooled, and shared memory.
fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: CXL.io carries the non-coherent I/O + config + enumeration plane (PCIe address spaces). CXL.mem exposes Host-managed Device Memory (HDM) as coherent system memory mapped via HDM Decoders. CXL.cache lets the device coherently cache host memory.

device_classification.type_1: CXL.io + CXL.cache — coherent accelerator, no device memory.
device_classification.type_2: CXL.io + CXL.cache + CXL.mem — accelerator with local memory.
